title: Dedicated pool rapid-replenish playbook and hotpatch for customer-facing capacity shortfall
creator: Maya Chen
description: Large enterprise customer experienced sustained capacity shortfalls during peak traffic that surfaced as 503s and request throttles. Initial triage reveals autoscaler leadership handoff race + headroom account desync in reserved pools; some burst credits were not reclaimed promptly, blocking rapid scale-ups. This ticket contains the emergency remediation playbook, a targeted hotpatch to fix quick state reconciliation, and the long-term autoscaler leadership/ledger fix plan.
steps_taken: 2026-02-14: Customer report received via CSM; created ticket and engaged on-call SRE (Luis O.).
2026-02-14: Scoped impact — affected tenant on Dedicated reserved pool in us-west-2; spike window correlates with weekly backup jobs.
2026-02-15: Collected telemetry (allocator, headroom, burst-ledger) and traced missed reclaim events to leader flaps during controller restarts.
2026-02-16: Deployed temporary fallback policy to route affected tenant to compatible standby pool while investigating (rollbackable via console route).
2026-02-18: Implemented and validated hotpatch: force-reconcile endpoint to rehydrate burst credits and refresh headroom in allocator; deployed to canary and then prod pool for the tenant.
2026-02-20: Customer observed 90% reduction in 503s after hotpatch; monitoring dashboard set up for 72h observation window.

2026-02-24: Root-cause confirmed: leadership handoff race during controller restarts allowed transient double-alloc and prevented proper backfill of burst credits; fixed by quick leader-election debounce and ledger reconciliation job.
2026-03-01: Preparing follow-up change to autoscaler to include idempotent incremental reconciler and stronger telemetry to detect drift early.
postmortem_note: If reconciliation job proves stable over 72h window, schedule full rollout and follow up with latency/cost analysis. Draft postmortem to include timeline, customer communication, and compensatory credits proposal.
next_steps: Finish review of autoscaler PR and merge to canary (owner: Priya Nair).
Extend reconciliation job to run opportunistically during low-load windows and add rate-limiter to avoid thrashing (owner: Luis Ortega).
Add synthetic canary load test that introduces leadership restarts to validate ledger consistency (owner: infra-team).
Coordinate customer comms: explain fix and prevention plan; propose 10% invoice credit for downtime window (owner: CSM - Jordan Lee).
